questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
She asked me / where was I going / after the meeting.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'where was I going'. Reported questions use statement word order: 'where I was going'.

questions.q: Choose the word that is most nearly SAME in meaning to: ABUNDANT
questions.x: 'Abundant' means plentiful. 'Scarce' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: She is fond ____ reading biographies.
questions.x: 'Fond of' is the correct collocation.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
Mathematics are / my favourite / subject at school.
questions.x: The error is in part (a): 'Mathematics are'. 'Mathematics' is singular: 'Mathematics is'.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: LENIENT
questions.x: 'Lenient' is the opposite of 'Strict'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Lenient'.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To burn the midnight oil' mean?
o: To work or study late into the night
questions.x: 'To burn the midnight oil' means: to work or study late into the night.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: HASTEN
questions.x: 'Hasten' is the opposite of 'Delay'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Hasten'.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'A person who loves mankind and promotes their welfare'
questions.x: 'Philanthropist' means a person who loves mankind and promotes their welfare.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Prudent'.
questions.x: 'Prudent' means sensible. 'Rash' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom: 'A blessing in disguise'
o: Something good that seemed bad at first
questions.x: 'A blessing in disguise' means: something good that seemed bad at first.

questions.q: According to the passage, how do fraudsters usually succeed?
o: By exploiting people's panic and urgency
questions.x: Answer: 'By exploiting people's panic and urgency'. The passage says fraudsters 'break people' using urgency. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Fraudsters rarely break technology; they break people. A caller posing as a bank official creates urgency — your account will be blocked unless you share the code now. Panic does the rest. The best defence is a simple rule practised until it becomes habit: no genuine institution asks for a one-time password, and no official will arrest you over a video call. Pause, disconnect and verify through an official number.

questions.q: Which rule does the author recommend practising?
o: Always share codes quickly to avoid blocking
No genuine institution asks for a one-time password
questions.x: Answer: 'No genuine institution asks for a one-time password'. This is the defensive rule stated. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Fraudsters rarely break technology; they break people. A caller posing as a bank official creates urgency — your account will be blocked unless you share the code now. Panic does the rest. The best defence is a simple rule practised until it becomes habit: no genuine institution asks for a one-time password, and no official will arrest you over a video call. Pause, disconnect and verify through an official number.

questions.q: The 1886 session of the Indian National Congress, presided over by Dadabhai Naoroji, was held at:
questions.x: It was held at Calcutta; it was the second session of the Congress.

questions.q: Who founded the Khudai Khidmatgar?
questions.x: The Khudai Khidmatgar was founded by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan.

questions.q: The 'Hindustan Socialist Republican Army' carried out the assassination of J. P. Saunders in 1928 to avenge:
o: The execution of Ram Prasad Bismil
The death of Lala Lajpat Rai
questions.x: Correct answer: The death of Lala Lajpat Rai. Saunders was mistaken for James Scott, who ordered the lathi charge.

questions.q: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 with the help of:
o: A. O. Hume, a retired British civil servant
questions.x: Hume's role led to the 'safety valve' theory, which historians debate.

questions.q:
In which year did the following take place?
The outbreak of the Revolt at Meerut.
questions.x: The outbreak of the Revolt at Meerut in 1857. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: The book 'Satyarth Prakash' was written by:
questions.x: 'Satyarth Prakash' was written by Swami Dayanand Saraswati.

questions.q: The Kisan Sabha movement in Awadh (1918–20) was associated with:
questions.x: Swami Sahajanand founded the Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (1929) and led the All India Kisan Sabha (1936).

questions.q: Who was the Viceroy of India at the time of the Partition and transfer of power (1947)?
questions.x: Lord Mountbatten was Viceroy during the Partition and transfer of power (1947).

questions.q: The Poona Pact (1932) provided for:
o: Reserved seats for depressed classes within joint electorates
questions.x: It replaced separate electorates under the Communal Award with more reserved seats in joint electorates.

questions.q:
In which year did the following take place?
The All-India Muslim League was founded at Dhaka.
questions.x: The All-India Muslim League was founded at Dhaka in 1906. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: India's 'TB Mukt Bharat' target aimed at eliminating tuberculosis by:
o: 2025, ahead of the SDG target of 2030
questions.x: Correct answer: 2025, ahead of the SDG target of 2030. The Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana gives nutritional support to TB patients.

questions.q: The headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organization is located in:
questions.x: Food and Agriculture Organization: headquartered in Rome.

questions.q: The 'Agnipath' scheme (2022) relates to:
o: Short-term recruitment of soldiers (Agniveers) for four years
questions.x: Correct answer: Short-term recruitment of soldiers (Agniveers) for four years. Up to 25% of Agniveers may be retained in regular service.

questions.q: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (Sardar Patel's birth anniversary) is observed on:
questions.x: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (Sardar Patel's birth anniversary): 31 October.

questions.q: The 'State of World Population Report' is published by:
o: FAO with IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO
questions.x: 'State of World Population Report' is brought out by UN Population Fund (UNFPA).

questions.q: 'Kavach', developed by Indian Railways, is:
o: An indigenous automatic train protection system
questions.x: Correct answer: An indigenous automatic train protection system. It prevents collisions and over-speeding.

questions.q: Which day is observed on 8 September?
questions.x: 8 September is International Literacy Day.

questions.q: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup in June 2024, defeating:
questions.x: Correct answer: South Africa. The final was played in Barbados.

questions.q: The Paris Agreement (2015) aims to limit global warming to well below:
o: 2 °C above pre-industrial levels, pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5 °C
questions.x: Countries submit Nationally Determined Contributions every five years.

questions.q: Who became the Chief of the Army Staff in June 2024?
questions.x: Admiral Dinesh K. Tripathi became Navy chief (April 2024) and Air Chief Marshal A. P. Singh became IAF chief (September 2024).

questions.q: The First Schedule of the Constitution contains:
o: Names of States and Union Territories and their territories
Powers, authority and responsibilities of Panchayats (29 subjects)
Emoluments and allowances of the President, Governors, Judges, CAG and others
questions.x: First Schedule: Names of States and Union Territories and their territories.

questions.q: A national emergency under Article 352 can be declared on the grounds of:
o: War, external aggression or armed rebellion
Failure of constitutional machinery in a State
questions.x: 'Armed rebellion' replaced 'internal disturbance' by the 44th Amendment.

questions.q: The constitutional amendment that removed the right to property from the list of Fundamental Rights was enacted in the year:
questions.x: This was the 44th Amendment Act, 1978.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Persons not to be deprived of property save by authority of law"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 300A.

questions.q: Gyanesh Kumar assumed office as Chief Election Commissioner in February 2025, succeeding:
questions.x: Correct answer: Rajiv Kumar. He was the first CEC appointed under the 2023 Act.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Procedure for impeachment of the President"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 61.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of Fundamental Rights"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 13.

questions.q: Under the Tenth Schedule, a merger of a legislature party is protected from disqualification if at least what fraction of members agree?
questions.x: The 91st Amendment removed protection for 'splits' (one-third) and kept only mergers backed by two-thirds.

questions.q: The Preamble declares India to be a:
questions.x: Correct answer: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic. 'Socialist' and 'Secular' were added by the 42nd Amendment (1976).

questions.q: Which constitutional amendment introduced the Goods and Services Tax?
questions.x: It was the 101st Amendment Act of 2016.

questions.q: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana aims to provide:
questions.x: Correct answer: Housing for all. PMAY has urban and rural (Gramin) components.

questions.q: The repo rate is the rate at which:
o: The RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks against securities
Banks pay interest on savings deposits
Banks lend to their best customers
questions.x: Correct answer: The RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks against securities. A higher repo rate makes borrowing costlier, tightening liquidity.

questions.q: If the CRR is 4% and SLR 18%, how much of a fresh deposit of ₹100 can a bank lend at most (ignoring other requirements)?
questions.x: Reserves = 4 + 18 = ₹22; lendable = ₹78.

questions.q: 'Demand-pull inflation' occurs when:
o: Aggregate demand exceeds aggregate supply at the current price level
questions.x: Correct answer: Aggregate demand exceeds aggregate supply at the current price level. Cost-push inflation stems from higher input costs.

questions.q:
In which year did the following happen?
Fourteen major commercial banks were nationalised.
questions.x: Fourteen major commercial banks were nationalised in 1969.

questions.q: The sector contributing the largest share of India's GVA is:
questions.x: Services contribute over half of GVA, while agriculture employs the largest share of workers.

questions.q: The main thrust of the Eleventh Five-Year Plan (2007–12) was:
o: Doubling per capita income in ten years; monitorable targets
Rapid industrialisation with heavy industries, based on the Mahalanobis model
Human resource development, in the context of economic reforms (Rao–Manmohan model)
questions.x: Eleventh Five-Year Plan (2007–12): Faster and more inclusive growth.

questions.q: 'Gross Fixed Capital Formation' is a measure of:
o: Investment in fixed assets like machinery and buildings
questions.x: Correct answer: Investment in fixed assets like machinery and buildings. GFCF as a share of GDP indicates the investment rate.

questions.q: A 'mixed economy' is one in which:
o: Both public and private sectors coexist
questions.x: Correct answer: Both public and private sectors coexist. India adopted a mixed economy after independence.

questions.q: A consumer price index rose from 194.7 to 210.3 over a year. The inflation rate (rounded to one decimal) is:
questions.x: Inflation = (New index − Old index)/Old index × 100 = (210.3 − 194.7)/194.7 × 100 ≈ 8%.

questions.q: Under AS 3 / Ind AS 7, cash flows are classified into:
questions.x: Correct answer: Operating, investing and financing activities. The three-way classification is mandatory.

questions.q: Fixed costs are ₹1,17,000, selling price is ₹230 per unit and variable cost is ₹200 per unit. The break-even point in units is:
questions.x:
Contribution per unit = 230 − 200 = ₹30.
BEP (units) = Fixed cost / Contribution per unit = 1,17,000 / 30 = 3,900 units.

questions.q: A machine is purchased for ₹1,50,000 and ₹9,000 is spent on its installation. Its estimated useful life is 8 years with a residual value of ₹6,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (1,50,000 + 9,000 − 6,000) / 8 = 1,53,000 / 8 = ₹19,125 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: A current ratio of 2 : 1 is traditionally considered:
questions.x: Correct answer: Satisfactory for short-term solvency. Current assets twice current liabilities provide a cushion.

questions.q: Purchases during a month: 1st — 300 units @ ₹18; 10th — 250 units @ ₹19; 20th — 300 units @ ₹23. 650 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 200 units left come from the latest purchases: 200 × ₹23 = ₹4,600.

questions.q: A business has total assets of ₹2,10,000 and outside liabilities of ₹45,000. Its capital (owner's equity) is:
questions.x: Assets = Liabilities + Capital → Capital = 2,10,000 − 45,000 = ₹1,65,000.

questions.q: A 'proforma invoice' is sent by the consignor to the consignee mainly to:
o: Give information about the goods and their price; it is not a sale
questions.x: Correct answer: Give information about the goods and their price; it is not a sale. Consignment is not a sale; ownership remains with the consignor.

questions.q: The business entity concept implies that:
o: The business is treated as separate from its owner for accounting purposes
questions.x: Transactions of the owner are recorded separately; capital introduced is a liability of the business to the owner.

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹1,20,000 is depreciated at 20% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 2 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 1,20,000 × (0.8)^2 = ₹76,800.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹72,000.)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Capital introduced by the proprietor is shown as a liability of the business.
2. Drawings by the proprietor increase capital.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is correct; Statement 2 is incorrect.
Under the entity concept, capital is owed to the owner; drawings reduce capital.

questions.q: P and Q share profits in the ratio 5 : 3. They admit R for a 1/6 share, which R acquires from P and Q in their existing ratio. The new profit-sharing ratio of P, Q and R is:
Under the golden rules, a personal account is debited when the person:
questions.x: Correct answer: Receives benefit (receiver). Debit the receiver, credit the giver.

questions.q: A trial balance is prepared to:
o: Check the arithmetical accuracy of ledger balances
questions.x: It lists debit and credit balances; agreement indicates arithmetical accuracy, not freedom from all errors.

questions.q: From the following, compute Gross Profit: Opening stock ₹40,000; Purchases ₹2,35,000; Sales ₹2,57,500; Closing stock ₹70,000.
questions.x:
Cost of goods sold = Opening stock + Purchases − Closing stock
= 40,000 + 2,35,000 − 70,000 = ₹2,05,000.
Gross profit = Net sales − COGS = 2,57,500 − 2,05,000 = ₹52,500.
Carriage inwards is a direct expense (Trading A/c).

questions.q: India became a member of the ILO in:
questions.x: India was a founder member of the ILO in 1919, before Independence.

questions.q: 'Collective bargaining' at the industry level across many firms (e.g., all ports or all banks) is called:
questions.x: Industry-wide bargaining covers many employers; plant-level bargaining covers a single unit.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, a worker becomes eligible for annual leave with wages after working for how many days in a calendar year?
questions.x: The eligibility was reduced from 240 days (Factories Act) to 180 days.

questions.q: Under the Code on Wages, the total deductions from an employee's wages in a wage period cannot exceed what share of the wages?
questions.x: Section 18 caps total authorised deductions at fifty per cent of the wages.

questions.q: The POSH Act requires the Internal Committee to complete its inquiry within:
questions.x: Correct answer: 90 days. Section 11(4): the inquiry is to be completed within ninety days.

questions.q: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 provides reservation in government establishments of not less than:
questions.x: Section 34 reserves at least 4% of vacancies for persons with benchmark disabilities (raised from 3% under the 1995 Act).

questions.q: Article 39(e) of the Constitution directs the State to ensure that:
o: The health and strength of workers and the tender age of children are not abused
Equal pay for equal work is secured
questions.x: Article 39(e) protects workers' health and children from abuse; 39(d) is equal pay; 39A is free legal aid.

questions.q: The Trade Unions Act was passed by the legislature in the year:
questions.x: The Trade Unions Act was enacted in 1926.

questions.q: The First National Commission on Labour (1966–69) was chaired by:
questions.x: Justice P. B. Gajendragadkar, a former Chief Justice of India, chaired the First NCL.

questions.q: 'Go-slow' by workers is generally treated by Indian courts as:
o: Serious misconduct, though it is not a 'strike' under the law
questions.x: Courts (e.g., Bharat Sugar Mills, 1961) treated go-slow as misconduct inviting disciplinary action, since workers remain on duty but withhold effort.

questions.q: Which type of unemployment exists when more people are engaged in a job than required, so that the marginal productivity of some workers is zero?
questions.x: Disguised unemployment is common in Indian agriculture where family members share work that fewer people could do.

questions.q: Which notice is an employer required to give before effecting a change in conditions of service such as wages or hours of work under the IR Code?
questions.x: Section 40 requires notice of at least twenty-one days before effecting a change in matters listed in the Third Schedule.

questions.q: In which year was the Workmen's Compensation Act (now Employees' Compensation Act) enacted?
questions.x: The Workmen's Compensation Act (now Employees' Compensation Act) was enacted in 1923.

questions.q: An establishment employs 9 workers but is engaged in a notified hazardous process. Under the Code on Social Security, ESI coverage:
o: Does not apply as the threshold is 10
Applies, as the Centre can notify hazardous or life-threatening occupations for coverage even with one employee
Applies only if workers request it
questions.x: The Code allows mandatory ESI coverage of establishments carrying on hazardous/life-threatening occupations even with one employee.

questions.q: Which case is famous for the expansion of Article 21 to require that any procedure depriving life or liberty be 'fair, just and reasonable', a principle later applied to service matters?
o: A.K. Gopalan v. State of Madras (1950)
Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978)
questions.x: Maneka Gandhi (1978) linked Articles 14, 19 and 21 and required fair procedure.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, a settlement arrived at in the course of conciliation is binding on:
o: No one unless approved by Parliament
All parties to the dispute, including present and future workers of the establishment
questions.x: A conciliation settlement binds all parties, all present and future workers of the establishment, and successors of the employer.

questions.q: The 'Varishtha Pension Bima Yojana' and PMVVY were pension products for senior citizens provided through:
questions.x: Both offered assured pensions via LIC, with the government bearing the interest differential.

questions.q: Under the ESI scheme, 'insured person' means:
o: An employee in respect of whom contributions are or were payable
questions.x: Correct answer: An employee in respect of whom contributions are or were payable. An IP is an employee covered under the ESI Act.

questions.q: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) provides health cover of up to:
questions.x: PM-JAY covers secondary and tertiary hospitalisation on a cashless basis.

questions.q: The formula for member pension under EPS 1995 is:
questions.x: Correct answer: Pensionable salary × pensionable service / 70. Monthly pension = pensionable salary × pensionable service ÷ 70.

questions.q: The standard rate of employee's contribution to EPF is:
o: 12% of basic wages plus DA and retaining allowance
questions.x: Both employer and employee contribute 12% (10% in specified cases) of basic wages, DA and retaining allowance.

questions.q: If an EPF member changes jobs, the PF account is:
o: Transferred to the new employer's account under the same UAN (auto-transfer facility)
questions.x: With UAN, the PF balance moves to the new member ID; auto-transfer is enabled where KYC is complete.

questions.q: An employee retires after 11 years of continuous service. Last drawn monthly wages (basic + DA) are ₹47,000. Gratuity payable under the statutory formula (non-seasonal establishment) is:
questions.x:
Gratuity = 15/26 × last drawn wages × completed years of service.
= 15/26 × 47,000 × 11 = ₹2,98,269 (well within the ₹20 lakh ceiling).
The divisor 26 reflects working days in a month.

questions.q: PM POSHAN (formerly Mid-Day Meal Scheme) provides hot cooked meals to children in:
o: Government and government-aided schools (Balvatika to Class VIII)
questions.x: PM POSHAN covers children in government and aided schools from Balvatika to Class VIII.

questions.q: A 'covered establishment' must display or report which identifier on all EPF correspondence?
questions.x: EPFO allots an establishment ID/code used in ECR and all correspondence.

questions.q: The Code on Social Security defines which categories of workers for the first time in central legislation?
o: Gig workers, platform workers and aggregators
questions.x: These new definitions allow social security schemes for the platform economy.

questions.q: An insured employee earns gross wages of ₹16,000 in a month. What is the total ESI contribution (employer + employee) payable for that month?
questions.x:
Employee share 0.75% = ₹120 → ₹120; employer share 3.25% = ₹520 → ₹520 (rounded up to the next rupee).
Total = ₹640 (4% of wages; rates in force since 1 July 2019).

questions.q: The National Food Security Act, 2013 provides subsidised foodgrains to up to what share of the rural and urban population respectively?
questions.x: Priority households get 5 kg per person per month; Antyodaya households get 35 kg per household.

questions.q: Deficiency of Iron causes:
questions.x: Iron deficiency → Anaemia.

questions.q: The chemical name/formula of 'plaster of paris' is:
questions.x: Plaster of Paris = CaSO₄·½H₂O (calcium sulphate hemihydrate).

questions.q: Which instrument is used to measure electric current?
questions.x: Ammeter measures electric current.

questions.q: Which vitamin is synthesised in the human skin on exposure to sunlight?
questions.x: Correct answer: Vitamin D. It helps calcium absorption.

questions.q: A transformer works only with:
questions.x: Correct answer: Alternating current. It uses mutual induction and needs a changing magnetic flux.

questions.q: The causative agent of tuberculosis is:
o: Dengue virus (a flavivirus spread by Aedes mosquitoes)
questions.x: Tuberculosis: Mycobacterium tuberculosis (bacterium).

questions.q: Laws of inheritance is credited to:
questions.x: Laws of inheritance: Gregor Mendel.

questions.q: The SI unit of power is the:
questions.x: Power is measured in Watts.

questions.q: The pH of pure water at 25 °C is:
questions.x: pH < 7 is acidic; > 7 is basic.

questions.q: The planet closest to the Sun is:
questions.x: Correct answer: Mercury. Venus is the hottest planet due to its thick CO₂ atmosphere.

questions.q: Which abbreviation stands for 'Universal Serial Bus'?
questions.x: Universal Serial Bus is abbreviated as USB.

questions.q: 'Phishing' is:
o: A method to speed up the internet
A fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information by pretending to be a trustworthy entity
questions.x: Correct answer: A fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information by pretending to be a trustworthy entity. Never share OTPs or passwords via email or calls.

questions.q: In a queue at a counter, Nisha is 25th from the front and 26th from the back. How many persons are there in all?
questions.x: Total = (position from front) + (position from back) − 1 = 25 + 26 − 1 = 50. Nisha is counted in both positions, hence −1.

questions.q: In a certain code language, COURT is written as FRXUW. How is SAFETY written in that code?
questions.x:
Compare COURT → FRXUW: C→F, O→R, U→X…
Rule: each letter is moved 3 places forward in the alphabet.
Applying it to SAFETY gives VDIHWB.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks his goods 20% above the cost price and allows a discount of 15% on the marked price. His gain or loss per cent is:
questions.x:
Let CP = 100. Marked price = 120.
SP after 15% discount = 120 × 0.85 = 102.
Gain = 102 − 100 = 2 on 100 → 2% gain.
Shortcut: m − d − md/100 = 20 − 15 − 3 = 2%.

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 2 : 5. After 6 years, the ratio will become 20 : 41. What is P's present age?
Three bells toll at intervals of 6, 40, 9 seconds respectively. If they start together, after how long will they next coincide?
questions.x:
They coincide after LCM(6, 40, 9) seconds.
LCM = 360 s = 6 min.

questions.q: 19 April 2004 was a Monday. What day of the week was 19 April 2011?
questions.x:
Each ordinary year shifts the day by 1, and a leap day (29 Feb) crossed in between adds 1 more.
Total days between the dates = 2556 = 365 weeks + 1 odd days.
Monday + 1 = Tuesday.

questions.q: In what ratio must coffee seeds costing ₹50 per kg be mixed with coffee seeds costing ₹140 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹68 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (140 − 68) : (68 − 50) = 72 : 18 = 4 : 1.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: Two inlet pipes can fill an overhead tank in 5 hours and 20 hours respectively, while an outlet pipe can empty the full tank in 12 hours. If all three are opened together on an empty tank, it will be full in:
questions.x:
Take tank capacity = LCM(5, 20, 12) = 60 units.
Rates: +12, +3, −5 units/hour → net 10 units/hour.
Time = 60 / 10 = 6 hours.

questions.q: The marks of students are: 72, 43, 69, 53, 46, 36, 51. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 370; number of values = 7. Mean = 370/7 = 52.86.

questions.q: Find the odd one out among 343, 125, 216 and 214.
questions.x: 216, 125, 343 are all perfect cubes; 214 is not. Hence 214 is the odd one out.

questions.q: What simple interest will ₹8,500 earn in 3 years at 6% per annum?
Team X can verify a batch of claims in 8 days and Team Y can do it in 56 days. Working together, they will finish it in:
questions.x:
One day's work: 1/8 + 1/56 = 64/448 = 1/7.
Together they need 7 days. (Product/Sum: 8×56/(8+56) = 7.)

questions.q: The average weight of 18 parcels is 67 kg. When one more parcel is added, the average becomes 70 kg. The weight of the new parcel is:
questions.x:
Old total = 18 × 67 = 1206 kg. New total = 19 × 70 = 1330 kg.
New parcel = 1330 − 1206 = 124 kg.
Shortcut: new value = new average + (increase × old count) = 70 + 3 × 18 = 124 kg.

questions.q: Meena starts from point O and walks 23 km towards South, then turns left and walks 24 km, then turns left and walks 27 km, and finally turns left and walks 21 km. How far is the person from O and in which direction?
questions.x:
Take O as origin, North/East positive.
North–South: -23 +27 = 4 km → 4 km North.
East–West: +24 -21 = 3 km → 3 km East.
Distance = √(3² + 4²) = 5 km, towards North-East.
